8.6.13. iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.pathgen.StraightCostEdges¶

class iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.pathgen.StraightCostEdges(railyard, noPrefix=False, noSuffix=False, branch=True, posOrient=None)¶

This class is deprecared and will be removed.
